articles.summary: Type One Energy is betting that its lean approach to fusion power will get a power plant on the grid faster, and investors have rewarded it with $200 million.

articles.title: Lucid Motors’ EV output falls to lowest level in almost 2 years

articles.title: OpenAI will start watermarking ChatGPT’s text in the EU
articles.summary: OpenAI will watermark ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU to comply with the AI Act. Editing can make the invisible marks harder to detect, it says.

articles.title: Etched fields funding offers at $40B+ valuation, sources say
articles.summary: Just a couple of months after its last big raise, the AI chip startup is already being plied with investment offers at double or more its current value, sources tell TechCrunch.

articles.title: After Factory’s public spat with Khosla, Menlo proudly invests
articles.summary: Days after Vinod Khosla called Factory a struggling also-ran, Menlo has shown up with a check and a glowing blog post.

articles.title: Reflection debuts Beam, an open-weight AI model to rival Chinese models at lower compute cost
articles.summary: Reflection is aiming Beam and future models at enterprises and sovereign nations. The pitch is to build “AI factories,” a product that would let institutions build their own customized, local AI system by training Reflection’s AI models on their own proprietary data.

articles.title: Instinct brings its AI agent to group chats, even for friends without an account
articles.summary: Instinct is launching group chats that let friends use its AI agent together for tasks like planning trips, organizing carpools, and coordinating events. The company says personal accounts remain separate, with permission required before personal agents share information or take action.

articles.title: TikTok rolls out an AI shopping assistant and one-click checkout
articles.summary: TikTok describes its new Shopping Assistant as a conversational AI agent designed to help users discover and purchase products.

articles.title: At 19, founder raises $11M for Ghost, maker of a $3,499 computer for personal AI
articles.summary: Ghost's first product is Core, a personal computer designed specifically for AI agents that can take actions on a person's behalf.
